hints: The spread happens everywhere at once, not one cell at a time. What kind of search explores everything at a given distance before going further?
A breadth-first search - but started from *every* spoiled cell at the same time, not from one of them.
Put every initially spoiled cell in the queue before the first minute. Then each round of the queue is one minute.
Process the queue one whole level at a time: take the number of cells currently in it, expand exactly those, and add a minute.
